subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the lifecycle defect is fixed, must this PR show a redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login run, or may the gateway regression suite receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: The external PR’s tests cover the generic gateway state machine, but only someone with an approved WeChat provider setup can verify that account A remains connected through account B login; automation cannot safely waive that merge gate.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real A+B login run provides redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online after account B is added.

options.title: Grant explicit proof override
options.body: Accept the focused gateway tests as sufficient after the lifecycle defect is repaired and record an explicit maintainer proof override.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real A+B login run provides redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history connects this owner to multi-account channel behavior, and the remaining choice is repository-level proof acceptance rather than a mechanical implementation question.
